programs.title: America's Wild Spaces
programs.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.

programs.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind: Season 1
programs.desc: Nat Geo Wild explores the beauty and ferocity of the animal kingdom, offering an intimate look at the world’s most incredible creatures in their habitats.

programs.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programs.desc: Saltwater crocodiles are Australia's most powerful predators.Over the last two centuries, ruthless hunting and the development of civilization have brought them to the brink of extinction.
